description:
What happens when a high-level diplomatic trip is suddenly blocked just hours before departure? In this case, the answer turned into a story of unexpected strategy and rapid adaptation.

After losing planned overflight access, Taiwan’s delegation faced what seemed like an impossible situation. Yet days later, the visit was completed — through a route few had anticipated.

In this episode, we reconstruct how the situation unfolded, from the initial disruption to the final arrival. By examining logistics, diplomatic norms, and regional dynamics, we explore what this episode reveals about modern geopolitics — where access, influence, and strategy intersect in real time.

#Geopolitics #Taiwan #Africa #Diplomacy #China #InternationalRelations #Analysis
title: Blocked, Then Rerouted: How Taiwan Reached Africa Against the Odds
